assertions.assertion: The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to the symptomatic episodes.
The denial was issued under reason code CO-50.
Reason code CO-50 indicates the service was not deemed medically necessary.
The medical necessity determination was made by Atlas Mutual.
